authority: Source preparation and bounded local controls only. No protected publication, real R2 producer execution, deployment, or qualification is accepted.

implementation.approval: Independently approved target descriptor and artifact-key fingerprints must appear together; runtime and request are snapshotted before asynchronous work. Client/channel and live normal-source revision/profile are checked before native phases.
implementation.worker: Owns the upload-only native invocation and whole native summary; parent owns the bounded complete upload observer. The child receives only writer bearer and artifact key, through an explicit environment, and one private Unix socket.
implementation.publication: Whole expected task closure and complete settled capture are joined; upload evidence is included inside the independently authenticated producer bundle. No uploaded summary/report JSON is accepted as authority.
implementation.limits: Target descriptor identity does not attest to the actual adapter process or IAM grant. The protected entrypoint must still own or verify the pinned adapter lifecycle and runtime/grant receipt.

confinementRepair.defect: Source-contained temporary files were hidden at original host paths but readable through the guest checkout alias. A read-only bind prevents writes but permits reads.
confinementRepair.probeScope: Actual unprivileged filesystem boundary probe, synthetic files only. No real secrets or native Turbo task were used.
confinementRepair.repair: Fresh scoped supervisor and experiment directories under private /tmp, mode0700, outside source/worktree/Git/dependency mounts; no source experiments writable bind. Worker resolves packages through an explicit node_modules link to the approved read-only runner tree.
confinementRepair.controls: Controlled supervisor test rejects a source-visible storage alias before request serialization; real filesystem cleanup assertions cover the scoped directory.
confinementRepair.historicalEvidence: Earlier source-contained synthetic file-confinement observations are insufficient for current acceptance. Repaired actual native confinement must be proved again. No evidence of persistent issuer material or production credential exposure was found.

focusedBeforeFinalAssertionRefinement.scope: Same production implementation; afterward one negative test was rewritten to assert no worker call before inspecting the typed result so deliberately removed guards produce serializable assertions.

quick.scope: Before that final test assertion refinement; current integrated replay remains required.

guardRemovalControls.scope: Actual temporary removal of source guards in owned checkout; controlled unit seams, not native Turbo proof

controls.test: refuses a private storage alias inside a source mount before writing the request
refuses an unapproved client or channel before starting either native phase

consume reviewed runtime alias and socket repairs through main
current normal-source stable/canary native matrix and repaired confinement

reversal: Keep the upload path unwired; stop trial consumers before reverting it. No production configuration or credential is changed by this source preparation.
